title: Menu
lead: Create reusable navigation trees and assign them to locations supported by the active template.

sections.title: Create a menu
steps: Open Menu → New menu. Enter a descriptive name, for example “Main navigation”.
Add page links, anchors or validated URLs. Choose parent relationships to build submenus, adjust order and select whether a link opens a new tab.
Save the menu. Use Edit from Overview to change its items; only eligible public targets appear on the site. The template supplies the visual navigation style.

sections.title: Choose a location
steps: In the menu editor, choose a location from the active template, an allowed navigation type and the intended page filter. Save and review the public destination.
The editor reads locations, permitted types and maximum depth from the active template manifest. Dynamic items and assignments stay in the menu repository.
Write direct plugin references in HTML/code. The Core resolves them automatically; existing saved bindings remain compatible.

sections.title: Recover changes
steps: Use Trash for recoverable removal and History for catalog revisions. Saves verify revisions and template state to prevent silent overwrites.

sections.title: Full public navigation data
steps: menu:tree(key: active-template location key) supplies name, type and items with label, href, slug, anchor, newTab and children. Up to five item levels are declared; submenu items use the same fields. Unpublished/private page targets are omitted. menu:location remains a compatible flat-card service.

Bind menu:tree with alias navigation. Write {{#navigation.items}}
  • {{label}}{{#children}}{{label}}{{/children}}
    • {{/navigation.items}} inside your own nav/ul markup. Layout and behavior belong to your template and authored HTML. Missing location assignments return an empty items list.

sections.title: Direct plugin data and template positions
body: Create a menu with a stable slug-shaped ID, select its navigation type and edit its items. Direct references return a tree; missing/private pages are omitted. For a hardcoded template position, assign the menu to the declared location in its editor. template.<slot> must be declared in the template manifest.
steps: Use the stable identifier or slug without dots. Explicit id.<value> and slug.<value> selectors disambiguate reserved names.
Place named query parameters before field paths; use sections (#) and inverted sections (^) for finite iteration and empty states.
Keep presentation in the receiving layout. Template positions require manifest declarations and source-plugin assignments.

sections.title: Search, sort and paginate the overview
body: The overview uses shared CMS table controls. Search and status/type filters are at the top; Clear resets filters. Click a column heading to select ascending or descending order; the active arrow identifies the current ordering.
steps: Use the icon controls and their translated tooltips. Search, clear and ordering restart at page one; page navigation preserves the selected filters and order.

The seven-position pager stays visible below the scrollable table. Ellipsis buttons open upward menus containing earlier or later pages outside the three displayed numbers. Use the keyboard or a page button to navigate.
Read the total results, displayed range/count and page totals below the pager. Unavailable directions and empty catalogs retain disabled controls.
